name: Files

offers.label: Read listing
offers.description: Reads the place `place` into this window's listing for it: a folder's entries, this device's

offers.label: Changed
offers.description: Runs when a watched folder changes: reads the folder shown again.

offers.label: Preview step
offers.description: Makes the previews of a few pictures in the folder shown that have none yet, as the window

offers.label: Go
offers.description: Goes to the place `place`, reading it: a folder of the workspace's tree, one picked on this

offers.label: Back
offers.description: Goes back to the place the person came from.

offers.label: Forward
offers.description: Goes forward again to the place the person left.

offers.label: Up
offers.description: Goes to the folder above the one shown.

offers.label: Show
offers.description: Shows `path` in this window: the folder itself when it is one, and the folder that holds it with

offers.label: Extract into
offers.description: Extracts the archive at `path` into `folder`, into a folder named after it there: what the

offers.label: Move into
offers.description: Moves the entries the person chose into `folder`, keeping a taken name both.

offers.label: Copy into
offers.description: Copies the entries the person chose into `folder`, keeping a taken name both.

offers.label: Send nearby
offers.description: Sends the entries the person chose to the nearby device `nearby`, as Nearby Send offers it.

offers.label: Dismiss notice
offers.description: Dismisses what the window last said went wrong.

offers.label: Refresh
offers.description: Reads the place shown again, so what changed on the disk shows.

offers.label: Ascending
offers.description: Sorts the folder shown oldest or smallest first, or the other way.

offers.label: Show grid
offers.description: Draws the folder as a grid of cards, or as rows.

offers.label: Choose view
offers.description: Draws the folder the way the segment at place `i` says: the list at 0, the grid at 1.

offers.label: Show hidden files
offers.description: Shows or hides the names that start with a dot.

offers.label: Set zoom
offers.description: Draws the entries at `step`: 0 smaller, 1 regular, 2 larger, as the two keys step it.

offers.label: Zoom in
offers.description: Draws the entries one step larger.

offers.label: Zoom out
offers.description: Draws the entries one step smaller.

offers.label: Open entry
offers.description: Opens the entry `e`: a folder in this window, a file in the app that opens its kind.

offers.label: Find openers
offers.description: Finds the apps that open the entry at `path`, for the person to choose one.

offers.label: Open with
offers.description: Opens the entry the person asked to open with in `chosen`, one of the apps offered.

offers.label: Close openers
offers.description: Puts away the apps offered for the entry the person asked to open with.

offers.label: Open terminal
offers.description: Opens a terminal in the folder at `folder`.

offers.label: Compress entry
offers.description: Packs the entry at `path` into a new archive beside it, named after it: `zip` picks a ZIP,

offers.label: Extract entry
offers.description: Extracts the archive at `path` into a new folder beside it, named after it.

offers.label: Touch entry
offers.description: A press on the entry at `path`: a folder opens as a person presses it once, and a file is

offers.label: Select all
offers.description: Chooses every entry the folder shown places: what a press on "Select all" does.

offers.label: Clear selection
offers.description: Chooses nothing.

offers.label: Note recent
offers.description: Notes that the file `path` was opened, so it stands under Recent.

offers.label: New folder
offers.description: Makes a folder named `name` in the place shown.

offers.label: Start new file
offers.description: Reads the person's `~/Templates`, so naming a new file can offer them.

offers.label: New from template
offers.description: Copies the template `template` into the place shown under `typed`'s name, or the template's.

offers.label: New file
offers.description: Makes a text file named `name` in the place shown, for the person to fill.

offers.label: Open drive
offers.description: Opens the drive `drive` and goes to where it is open, so a removable disk is a place like any

offers.label: Open picked folder
offers.description: Opens the folder the person picked on this device: what the system's chooser asks, and the

offers.label: Rename entry
offers.description: Renames the entry at `path` to `name` in its own folder.

offers.label: Restore
offers.description: Restores the trashed entry `name` to where it came from.

offers.label: Delete permanently
offers.description: Removes the entry at `path` for good.

offers.label: Empty Trash
offers.description: Empties this device's trash: every entry, and the receipt that would put it back.

offers.label: Carry selection
offers.description: Remembers the entries the person chose as what a paste copies.

offers.label: Compress selection
offers.description: Packs the entries the person chose into one archive beside them: `zip` picks a ZIP, and TAR.ZST

offers.label: Paste
offers.description: Pastes what the person carries into the place shown, as the device's own work that says how

offers.label: Free name
offers.description: A name `folder` does not hold yet, for an entry that would land as `name`: the name itself, or

offers.label: Key on
offers.description: A key pressed on the row `focused`: what Files does with a copy, a cut or a delete over the

offers.label: Carry row
offers.description: Remembers what a copy from the row at `path` takes: the entries the person chose when that row

offers.label: Trash row
offers.description: Moves to Trash what a delete from the row at `path` takes: the entries the person chose when

offers.label: Add to Favorites
offers.description: Marks the place `place` in the sidebar.

offers.label: Remove from Favorites
offers.description: Takes the place `place` out of the sidebar's favorites.

offers.label: Inspect
offers.description: Reads what the chosen entry is, so the inspector says its size, its kind and its path, and

offers.label: Name it
offers.description: Does what the name asked of the person is for: makes the folder or the file, or renames the

offers.label: Open app
offers.description: Opens the app `a`, as pressing its row does.
